2654.title: Plugin command timeout state
2654.rootCauseOneLine: Two current-main clean runs distinguish pre-dispatch discovery failure (3 GET, 0 POST) from post-dispatch response loss (fetch failed); historical duplicate writes remain unexplained.
2654.proposedFix: Consider explicit outcome-unknown wording for a dispatched POST response loss; correlate per-attempt receipts and test server idempotency before changing write semantics.
2654.caveats: 2026-09-30: two normal clean installs/builds, 35 existing proxy tests per run and four synthetic HTTP scenarios. Fixture acceptance counters are not real persisted writes; bb 0.39.0, macOS load, task deduplication and historical duplicate cause remain unverified.
